scope: Agent review of actual native candidate captures and ordinary input/provider/disk evidence; not a human study or full accessibility qualification.
findings: The four shared Settings categories, accent/theme/wallpaper choices and preview footer remain readable and reachable at compact light/dark, actual 150% and physical 4K.
Competing visual controls are visibly disabled with an owner explanation; actual modal scale-close refusal leaves unsaved work and its dialog intact.
Input clearly says that its choices save immediately, and the real saved keyboard status is distinct from visual Apply/Cancel.
The actual malformed-record fallback remains usable and offers an explicit Apply recovery. Independent valid filesystem CRCs distinguish semantic refusal from accidental whole-volume damage.

carry_forward.observation: Retain prior menu/footer/Start/Editor and background transfer/modal work. Refine the fallback wording valid record to plain user choices, and make the System category idle footer contextual instead of repeating the Input explanation.
Retain cursor/hit and explicit-scale minimum reconciliation and keyboard focus/hint refinement.
Retain bounded shadow edge-span evaluation and actual renderer equivalence.
Retain the named BIOS/AHCI observation, full controller/original-app matrix and custom-domain email-sharing observation.
